security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — PRA scenarios contain market-sensitive assumptions
security.access_control: Restricted to authorised Risk Management team members; no customer data involved at this phase
security.audit: Scenario load event logged with model version and PRA scenario reference

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — batch compute; SLA is days not seconds

security.access_control: Output data restricted to Risk Management and Finance teams; embargoed until PRA publication
security.audit: Model run parameters and output checksums logged for Model Validation audit trail (SS1/23)

per_phase_nfrs.availability: Internal process — no system availability SLA

security.access_control: Board members and ExCo only. SMF attestation signatures stored securely.
security.audit: Board sign-off and SMF attestation recorded with timestamps

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — submission deadline is a hard regulatory obligation

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — contains stressed capital projections
security.access_control: Submission restricted to authorised regulatory reporting staff. PRA portal credentials are privileged.
security.audit: Submission confirmation reference and timestamp logged immutably

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Stress Test Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: StressTestExercise records, model outputs, and RegulatorySubmission records retained for minimum 7 years. Required for PRA supervisory review and potential enforcement defence.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: PRA supervisory window; model documentation requirements under SS1/23.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Model Version Control
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All risk models used in the stress test must be version-controlled and have a current Model Validation sign-off per SS1/23. Stress test output must record model_version for each sub-model used.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: PRA SS1/23 requires model governance documentation for stress test submissions.

regulatory_slas.name: PRA Annual Concurrent Stress Test Submission Deadline
regulatory_slas.requirement: Bank must submit completed stress test data templates to PRA by the deadline specified in the PRA's annual stress test documentation (typically Q2/Q3).
regulatory_slas.source: PRA Annual Concurrent Stress Test framework, Bank of England Act 1998
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: PRA supervisory escalation; potential Pillar 2A capital add-on; public disclosure of non-participation

regulatory_slas.name: SS1/23 Model Risk — Model Validation Before Use
regulatory_slas.requirement: All models used in regulatory stress tests must be validated and signed off before use in a submission.
regulatory_slas.source: PRA SS1/23 — Model Risk Management Principles for Banks
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: PRA may reject submission; supervisory note; potential enforcement action for material model risk failures
